THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under the Section 7
Land Ministry Number: LD/05/2004/FR/32.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, As land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: The Allotment of known as Morning side Watta, Shantha Ronas watta and shown as Lot 852 and 853 sheet Number 02 and supplement number 02 and Lot 858 and 859 sheet number 03 and supplement number 03 (04 block) of land in total extend of about 62.0215 Hectares, Depicted sheet in number 06 and supplement number 05 of F.V.P 932 situated Ilumbakanda village and Ilumbakanda Grama Niladhari division in UDA Pattu of Kukulu korale in Kalawana Divisional Secretariat division of Ratnapura District Sabaragamuwa Province.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under the Section 7
My Reference No.: PLDS/LND04/ACQ/25.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, As Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: Lot No.:— 1031 as depicted in the Sheet No. 39 and the Extra No. 39 in the Final Village Plan No. 16, prepared by the Surveyor General Rathnapura, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of 172A Welimaluwa in Meda Paththuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pelmadulla of Rathnapura District in Sabaragamuwa Province.
01. Lot No. 1031 North: Lot No. 113, 112 and 130; East: Lot No. 113, 112 and 130; South: Lot No. 159, 129, 112, 127 and 126; West: Lot No. 129, 112, 127 and 126.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat Office of Pelmadulla on the 11th Wednesday of March, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 25th February, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the

acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. A. SUGATH SISIRA KUMARA, Divisional Secretary, Pelmadulla. Divisional Secretariat Office, Pelmadulla, 22nd January, 2015. 02 - 612
